page.overview:
Who is Pirithous?

Pirithous (Greek: Πειρίθοος or Πειρίθους) was the King of the Lapiths in Thessaly and husband of Hippodamia, at whose wedding the famous Battle of Lapiths and Centaurs occurred; as well as the close friend of the hero Theseus.
